entities.name: Ellen Brusewitz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ellen Maria Brusewitz was a Swedish tennis player. She competed in the women's outdoor singles event at the 1912 Summer Olympics and finished seventh, behind her younger sister Annie Holmström.
